allow: Bash(timeout 60 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null; do sleep 2; done')

Bash(node -e "const {chromium} = require\('playwright'\); chromium.launch\(\).then\(async b=>{console.log\('launch ok'\); await b.close\(\);}\).catch\(e=>{console.error\('launch fail', e.message\); process.exit\(1\)}\);")

PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conn\) { $conn | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -Confirm:$false; Write-Output "Killed PID $\($_.OwningProcess\)" } } else { Write-Output "No listener on 3000" })
